labs.pi_title: Director, Tufts University Center for Cellular Agriculture; Stern Family Endowed Professor of Engineering; Distinguished University Professor; Professor of Biomedical Engineering
labs.admin_name: Matt McNulty (Associate Director); Meera Zassenhaus (Head of Communications); Scott Frost (Program Manager, USDA National Institute for Cellular Agriculture)
labs.research_summary: Biopolymer engineering, tissue engineering, regenerative medicine and cellular agriculture.
labs.notes: David Kaplan is also Director of INSciDE (tufts-insciDE.json) and Executive Director of the Allen Discovery Center via colleague roles -- the Center for Cellular Agriculture is a distinct, separately funded center with its own staff.

notes: Cross-cutting, cross-school center (School of Engineering, School of Arts and Sciences, Cummings School of Veterinary Medicine). Beyond Director Kaplan, its Faculty and Staff page lists ~10 more cross-appointed faculty whose primary labs are in other departments -- Kyongbum Lee (Dean of Engineering; ChemE), Merredith Portsmore (CEEO), Nik Nair, Ayse Asatekin (both Chemical and Biological Engineering -- see tufts-cbe.json), Qiaobing Xu (Biomedical Engineering -- see tufts-bme.json), Barry Trimmer, Ben Wolfe (Biology -- see tufts-biology.json and tufts-icdo.json for Trimmer), Scott Frost, Charles Mace (Chemistry -- see tufts-chemistry.json), Eugene White and David Matsas (Cummings School of Veterinary Medicine, not yet a scraped target) -- not duplicated here as full lab entries.
